rollback_boundary.meaning: Verified Micro main HEAD before any change. Returning to it fully undoes the brand activation.

procedure: git checkout main  # already at the boundary; main was never modified
git branch -D micro-brand-assets-motion-splash-resume-20260915 micro-brand-assets-motion-splash-resume-bridge-20260915  # drop the review branches
git push origin --delete micro-brand-assets-motion-splash-resume-20260915 micro-brand-assets-motion-splash-resume-bridge-20260915  # optional remote cleanup
